scope: Arnesano, Italy · sector 1 · open-field tomato · historical replay only
unit: sensor-scale percentage points (not calibrated field VWC)
timezone: Europe/Rome naive source timestamps; no DST correction
target: Mean sensor reading for the completed hour 24 clock-hours after origin
limitations: One sector and season; observational, not causal. Future irrigation is unknown. Sensor faults and missingness may bias evaluation. Not validated on other fields, crops or sensor scales. No irrigation dose, safe-delay or water-saving claim.
